{{Top|leg}}
The '''Black Hammer pirates''' were a [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] organization that operated during the time of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. In [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]], the [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] sold the [[Sentinel-class landing craft/Legends|''Sentinel''-class landing craft]] [[Freebird (Sentinel-class)|''Freebird'']] to a group of Black Hammer pirates, while in the [[City/Legends|city]] [[Gal'fian'deprisi]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Galantos]]. The Black Hammer pirates were headquartered in a [[Black Hammer pirate base|base]] in the [[Chirk'pn Wastes]], at the edge of Galantos' [[Gar'glum Sea]]. Their leader was the [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] [[Stima Ardella]].
